fields.name: Poppy Thistlewhip
fields.description: Could be any age 25-45; forgettable face
fields.unique_thing: I faked my own death to escape the consequences of my dubious past decisions. I am the only person known to ever have evaded the Dwarf King's justice.

powers.name: Evasive Strike
powers.desc:
Same as rogue basic melee attack except...
Hit: Same basic attack damage, and you can pop free from the target

powers.name: Flying Blade (1 bravado point optional)
powers.desc:
Same as rogue basic ranged attack except...
Special: You must use a small, bladed weapon or a hand crossbow with this attack.
Bravado: Spend 1 bravado to add your Rush Attack or Sneak Attack damage to the hit, even if the target would not normally be eligible for that damage. (feats give you benefits to using this without spending bravado)
Target: One nearby enemy

powers.name: Roll With It (1 bravado point optional)
powers.desc:
Trigger: A melee attack that targets AC hits you
Effect: Reduce the damage from the attack by double your level.
Bravado: Spend 1 bravado to take half damage instead.

powers.name: Sure Cut (1 bravado point)
powers.desc:
Special: You must be able to deal your Sneak Attack or Rush Attack damage to the target.
Target: One enemy
Attack: Same as normal melee attack
Hit: Weapon damage + level + Sneak/Rush damage (same as normal Sneak/Rush attack)
Miss: Level + Sneak/Rush damage (no base weapon damage)

spells.name: Chant of Endings
spells.desc:
Target: The nearby enemy with the fewest hit points (you choose if there’s a tie; you also don’t have to be able to see that enemy)
Attack: Intelligence + Level vs. MD (+5)
Hit: 1d10 + Intelligence necro damage.

spells.name: Command Undead
spells.desc:
Target: One nearby undead creature with 64 hp or fewer
Attack: Intelligence + Level vs. MD
Hit: The target is confused (hard save ends, 16+).
ADV FEAT: Miss does not expend spell

spells.name: Unholy Blast
spells.desc:
Target: One nearby enemy
Attack: Intelligence + Level vs. PD
Hit: 4d6 + Intelligence negative energy damage.
First Miss: Half damage, and make the attack again against an
enemy you haven’t already targeted with unholy blast this turn.
Second Miss: Half damage, or full damage if the escalation die is
1+ and you choose to decrease it by 1.

spells.name: Summon Undead
spells.desc:
Effect: You summon a mob of 1d3 + 1 crumbling skeleton mooks, as per the summoning rules on page 11. These skeletons fight for you until the end of the battle or until they drop to 0 hp, whichever comes first.

1st level mook [undead]
Initiative: +6 Vulnerability: holy
Sword +6 vs. AC—3 damage+CHA (First attack extra +CHA (3) vs AC)
Resist weapons 16+: When a weapon attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.
AC 16, PD 14, MD 10, HP 6 (mook)
Mook: Kill one crumbling skeleton mook for every 6 damage you deal to the mob.

spells.name: Terror
spells.desc:
One nearby enemy <= 50hp
Attack: Intelligence + Level vs. MD
Hit: The target uses all its actions during its turn to move away from the battle, disengaging from enemies to do so (hard save ends, 16+). If it fails to disengage with all of its actions, it won’t take opportunity attacks by moving. The effect also ends when you or one of your allies attacks the target.
Miss: 1d10 + Intelligence psychic damage

features.name: Bravado
features.desc:
Bravado has no limit. It resets 0 when you take a quick rest or a full heal-up.
You can gain bravado in 2 ways:
- Initiative: You gain a point of Bravado when your natural initiative roll is even.
- Hitting: You also gain a point of Bravado the first time you hit with a rogue attack on each of your turns. (Hitting with an opportunity attack won’t give you a point of Bravado.)

features.name: Rush Attack
features.desc:
Once on each of your turns, your rogue melee weapon attack deals an additional +1d6 damage against an enemy you were not engaged with at the start of your turn if you hit. Decide whether you are using Rush Attack before rolling an eligible attack.
2nd +5 (2d4) damage
3rd +7 (2d6) damage
4th +9 (2d8) damage
5th +11 (2d10) damage
6th +14 (4d6) damage
7th +18 (4d8) damage
8th +22 damage
9th +30 damage
10th +40 damage
11th +50 damage
12th +60 damage

ADV FEAT: When the escalation die is 2+, bump up your Rush Attack damage by two levels.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.desc:
Once on your turn, when you make a rogue melee weapon attack against an enemy engaged with one or more of your allies, you can deal +3 (1d4) damage if your attack hits.
Special: For each Sneak Attack feat you choose, bump up your Sneak Attack damage by one level. For example, if you’re 5th level with both the adventurer-tier and champion-tier feats, you deal Sneak Attack damage at 7th level.
2nd +4 (1d6) damage
3rd +5 (1d8) damage
4th +7 (2d6) damage
5th +9 (2d8) damage
6th +11 (3d6) damage
7th +14 (4d6) damage
8th +20 damage
9th +25 damage
10th +30 damage
11th +40 damage
12th +50 damage
13th +60 damage

talents.name: Both Styles Now
talents.desc:
You have both Rush Attack and Sneak Attack class features.
You can’t use both Rush Attack and Sneak Attack at the same time.
Choose as you make an attack whether you are using Rush Attack or Sneak Attack

talents.name: Murderous
talents.desc: Your crit range against staggered enemies expands by 2.

talents.name: Shift, Wriggle, and Roll
talents.desc: Once per battle, when you are hit by a nearby enemy, you can force the enemy to reroll the attack with an attack penalty equal to your highest mental ability modifier

talents.name: Smooth Talk (feat)
talents.desc:
3x uses /arc increasing to 4x uses arc at epic-tier.
Reroll a failed skill check involving social interaction, diplomacy, or other personal interactions between free-willed beings. Similarly, for a single use of Social Skill, a bard can allow a nearby ally to reroll such a skill check.
For an additional use of Social Skill (i.e. 2 uses total), decided before the reroll, the bard tells everyone how something they do, or did before, or arranged ahead of time, is now providing a +3 bonus on the skill reroll.

kinPowers.name: Evasive
kinPowers.desc: Once per battle, force an enemy that hits you with an attack to reroll the attack with a –2 penalty and keep the second result
